units.characteristics: the un-seeking heart that has turned back from the LORD
units.gist: 'I will utterly sweep away everything'; against Baal-worshippers and 'those who have turned back from following the LORD, who do not SEEK the LORD or inquire of him' - judgment on the heart that has stopped seeking

units.characteristics: the complacent heart (practical deism - God will do neither good nor ill)
units.gist: GEM - the day of the LORD; 'I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men who are COMPLACENT, those who say IN THEIR HEARTS, the LORD will not do good, nor will he do ill' - the settled apathy that thinks God irrelevant

units.characteristics: the day of wrath; false securities fail
units.gist: 'the great day of the LORD is near... a day of wrath, distress, darkness'; 'neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them' - no wealth ransoms the self on the day

units.characteristics: the appeal to humble seeking (seek the LORD, righteousness, humility)
units.gist: GEM - 'gather, O shameless nation... SEEK THE LORD, all you humble of the land who do his just commands; seek righteousness; seek HUMILITY; perhaps you may be hidden on the day of anger' - the sheltered posture of the humble seeker

units.characteristics: pride and self-deification (I am, and there is no one else)
units.gist: GEM - oracles against Philistia, Moab/Ammon (their PRIDE, taunts, boasts), Cush, Nineveh; 'this is the exultant city that lived securely, that SAID IN HER HEART, I am, and there is no one else' - the self-deifying pride that plays God

GEM - 'she LISTENS TO NO VOICE; she accepts NO CORRECTION; she does not TRUST in the LORD; she does not DRAW NEAR to her God'; corrupt officials/prophets/priests; 'the LORD within her is righteous... but the unjust KNOWS NO SHAME'

units.characteristics: the humble and lowly remnant who seek refuge in the LORD
units.gist: pure speech; 'I will remove your PROUDLY EXULTANT ones... I will leave a people HUMBLE AND LOWLY. They shall SEEK REFUGE in the name of the LORD; do no injustice, speak no lies' - pride removed, the humble sheltered remnant

units.characteristics: God rejoicing, quieting by love, singing over his people
units.gist: THE GEM - 'Sing aloud, O daughter of Zion... The LORD your God is in your midst, a mighty one who will save; he will REJOICE over you with gladness; he will QUIET YOU BY HIS LOVE; he will EXULT over you with loud singing' - the God who sings over his people
